error.message: The EasyEDA tab is hidden, so the canvas is not repainted and a capture would be stale (nothing was captured). Bring the EasyEDA window to the front and retry, or render from fresh readback (no tracks/pours): `easyeda pcb dump --include-copper --out board.json && easyeda pcb layout render --actual --board board.json --out board.svg`. Schematic pages export in the background with `easyeda sch export-image`.
